title: DeliveryAssigned
description: `data` of the delivery.assigned event, published by delivery-service when a rider is given an order (again after a reassignment). Keyed by orderId.

riderId.description: auth-service user id of the rider

riderPhone.description: E.164, for the customer and restaurant to call

customerId.description: Who ordered; notification-service tells them who their rider is

customerPhone.description: E.164, for the rider to call

restaurantName.description: Where the rider collects the order
